recommendation: Keep this audit as-is. Future common-concept additions should be made through targeted work-group decisions for specific data categories rather than reopening this broad 2015 request.
issue_request: FHIR-7663 was Published/Persuasive and asked for a document explaining how common healthcare data types, such as billing data, laboratory results, problem lists, and encounter diagnoses, should be represented in FHIR. The accepted resolution was to do this as part of resourceguide.html.
initial_application: Git-svn revision 6741, represented by commit bb5e3f2a9fcb50aecda21994cda00fdc6981b0c8, explicitly says '#7663 & #5374 - draft resource guide' and added the common-concepts table to source/resourceguide.html.
additional_context: source/resourceguide.html is still in build scope through publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml. Later FHIR-43371 clarified that the page is intended to describe a subset of common clinical terms rather than every resource or data category. Broader Resource Guide issues FHIR-7477, FHIR-7290, and FHIR-7038 were already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source already contains the requested common-concepts guidance, and expanding it into a new exhaustive catalog would exceed the later approved scope of the page.
